a-novel-concept-a-death-a-day-mc-will-li:
Can you get used to dying? Not really.
When a particular universe was born, its seven primordial Concepts acquired an ego. Omniscient and omnipotent, they seek since to enrich their home. To do so, they plunder other universes, capture young civilizations and plagiarize ideas. Many monsters, gods, civilizations, and races are competing for the eighth throne.
Eons later, it is Earth's turn to be torn away from its Sun.
Humanity begins its integration by participating in a Tutorial. Priam has the luck and the misfortune to finish the Tutorial first. Luck because his reward is a form of pseudo-immortality. Misfortune, because as the champion of his civilization, he is transported to Elysium, the most dangerous world created by the Concepts. Nine out of ten champions lose their lives there on their first day. Fortunately for Priam, he has many lives.
a-world-of-cultivation-i-possess:
Chen Mobai, a male protagonist and a third-year student of Xianmen, is currently working hard to review and prepare for the entrance exam of the Daodao Institute.
Originally, his biggest dream in life was to successfully establish a Foundation, until he was able to travel to another world of cultivation, and then his dream changed...
When Wei Yuan finally had the opportunity to lie on a wooden chair and bask in the sun during a peaceful era, countless demons and monsters had already been sealed in the museum behind him.
a-wrong-surrogate-for-the-ceo:
Lara's trauma went from mild to chronic when she divorced her husband and went ahead to get inseminated from a sperm bank. She wants to be a single mother. Love has become a fairytale and men were only a bunch of liars and deceivers. She's done with marriage and love. Being a single mother would be the best decision she'd ever made.
How would she have known that she made the wrong decision at that moment and fate turned her failure to fortune when she realised that she was carrying the child of the billionaire mogul Curtis Rodney.
“You have just an option…” Curtis declared. Other options do not apply to him, he always has his way and the woman before him now has no option but to accept his decision as her only option.
“And what is this option of yours?” Lara snapped at him.
apocalypse-ground-zero-refusing-to-leave:
I died once. Got stoned to death by a mob because a pretty girl with a heroine halo got jealous of my usefulness. Last thing I heard was her confession...she was the one who opened the gates to let the zombies in and pinned it on me.
It was real touching stuff.
The next thing I knew, I woke up in silk pajamas with a second chance.
Here's the thing about knowing the apocalypse is coming: you prepare. I emptied grocery stores, stole weapons, filled a spatial storage with enough supplies to outlast the end of the world. I also learned my lesson about powers—they drain your life force, and I'm not dying twice for the privilege of throwing vines around.
So I stayed home in the mansion I shared with my guardian and his head of security.
But I decided to take the last bit of advice I had been given in my previous life: 'Stay home.'
Done. I'm not going anywhere and no one is going to be able to move me if I don't want.
Unfortunately for me, I stole the wrong thing in this life, and now I have another two men in my house who think that I don't know what I am doing.
Four men...a billionaire guardian, his head of security, a weapons dealer, and his quiet enforcer...…
becoming-the-strongest-as-a-game-dev:
In a fascinating new world, Sam finds himself reincarnated as a developer of unique simulations for a society of monster hunters known as “Hunters.”
These skilled individuals employ advanced simulations to sharpen their abilities and acquire new skills essential for their dangerous profession.
Drawing from the popular video games of his past life, Sam crafts immersive experiences that challenge and prepare the Hunters for the perils they face.
As he navigates this thrilling realm, he discovers the impact of his creations and the true essence of bravery in the fight against formidable monsters.
beyond-the-blaze:
Akirion: The Awakening of a Young Warrior
In a quiet village miles away from the bustling capital, a young boy named Akirion leads an ordinary life with his loving parents. That innocence is shattered one fateful day when their home is attacked, claiming the lives of his family and leaving him heartbroken. Amidst his grief, Akirion discovers a hidden gift—his latent magical powers awakening at just ten years old.
Determined to rise above his tragedy, Akirion finds hope in a legendary swordmaster who trains young warriors in the art of combat and magic. With no wealth to his name, he earns his place through unwavering determination, living under the swordmaster’s roof for five relentless years. Through grueling training, he hones his magic and swordsmanship, forging himself into a formidable fighter.
Now, on the cusp of his destiny, Akirion prepares to confront the darkness that took his family—and to carve his path as a hero. His journey is one of loss, resilience, and the unbreakable spirit of a boy who refuses to give up.

divine-talisman-grandmaster:

Despite knowing his limitations, he worked tirelessly, driven by his dream and gratitude towards a childhood friend who helped him secure a spot in a prestigious high school. However, with a less developed Brain Domain, his prospects for further education and becoming a cultivator were bleak. His hard work seemed in vain when, six months before the crucial entrance exam, the girl he cherished rejected him, claiming their worlds were too different for their paths to cross again.

I was just taking a quiet late-night walk when I found… a child sleeping inside a dumpster.
One thing led to another, and suddenly I became the accidental father of a kid no older than ten.

But the real nightmare started when a floating screen appeared in front of me, spouting nonsense about quests and objectives.

Every time they met, she would properly call him “Doctor Lu.”
……
One day, while Lu Han was taking a nap, Tang Su slipped into his office.
The duty nurse shot up in surprise, shouting “Stop” as she followed after Tang Su.
By the time the nurse arrived, Tang Su was sitting in the chair, stretching out her leg to hook Lu Han's, coquettishly asking, “Doctor Lu, my leg hurts, could you take a look?”
Lu Han stepped back and turned to the nurse, “You go out first, I'll handle this.”
The nurse nodded, considerately closing the door behind her while muttering to herself that she didn't know how many women had thrown themselves at Doctor Lu. Each one of them had left crying.
After a while, the office door opened.
The nurse looked up to see that Tang Su as expected, was limping out with reddened eyes.
The nurse smiled knowingly, thinking that Tang Su had overestimated herself.
Soon after, Lu Han hurried out of his office.…

On their third wedding anniversary, Qin Xi excitedly told Lu Bochen about her pregnancy, only to receive a 1 billion yuan check, an order to abort the child, and divorce papers in return.
To protect her child, she fled.
Five years later, she returned with her adorable twins and had become a revered miracle doctor in the medical field, with countless admirers.
He regretted it. Qin Xi coldly watched as Lu Bochen, the CEO, apologized publicly on a live stream, “Weren't you the one who wanted a divorce and didn't want the child?”
He humbly begged, “Xi Xi, I want to remarry and have the child.”
“In your dreams.”
“Xi Xi, the kids need a father.”
The adorable twins stood with their hands on their hips in unison, “We don't need a daddy who bullies mommy.”
Lu Bochen, who had even his bedding and luggage thrown out of the room, didn't dare lose his temper, “Take a good look and see who's really bullying whom!”
super-rich-fantasy-i-grow-stronger-by-sp:
Ye Xuan came from a normal but extremely wealthy family. Yet, one day, when he woke up, he realized that he had been transmigrated to a fantasy world.
He was prepared to train and embark on an adventure, but he quickly learned that he had actually become the young master of Thousand Realms, the biggest trade company.
His father even let him inherit more than trillions of spirit stones.
“Are you serious? I’m sick of being rich!” Ye Xuan complained.
Fortunately, he had awakened a system that would make him stronger by spending money.
With that, he used the Grade 9 Celestial Pill to feed his dogs.
He used the famous painting that contained the will of the Supreme Sword to start a fire.
He used the Five-elements Divine Talisman to clean his ass.
And yet, he still had much more to spend. He then decided to join a clan that no one had even heard of.
He spent thousands just to see the saintess of the clan smile.
He built a pill alchemy workshop and gave out high-grade celestial herbs for free, and yet, one of the disciples who had never made a single pill was actually talented and was able to create the high-grade celestial pills.…
supreme-swordsman-of-the-nine-heavens:
I thought the world was vast, for me to wander, but now, it has only become a cage. For a life unhindered, I wield a single sword to pierce the ninth heavens. People find me displeasing, but there’s nothing they can do. That’s the kind of life I love!
“Stop! I paved this path and I planted these trees. If you want to pass through…”
“Brother, I come from the Dustfallen sect.”
“What? The Dustfallen sect! Piss off!”
This pitiful sect was so poor to the point where even bandits did not want to waste time on it. However, how could this sect, these nine measly people, be ordinary? What you see is only what they wish for you to see. What you can’t see is the truth!
Mu Yu—a young human boy with the powers of elemental demons—accidentally joins the impoverished Dustfallen sect. The sect that even bandits did not want to waste time on was actually hid great talents, concealing a huge secret! You look down on my sect? Then that’s your ignorance!
the-beautiful-teaching-assistant-gave-me:
Freshman orientation season.
As a third-year senior, Xiao Fei regularly comes to the school gate to welcome new students.
Unexpectedly, he accidentally runs into the new goddess teacher, Tang Yuxin, and discovers that she is actually the girl with whom he spent a night in a hotel a year ago.
What surprises Xiao Fei even more is that Tang Yuxin is pregnant with his child.
And not just one child—three!
Thus, the two begin a shameless cohabitation life right under the eyes of the students…
the-five-evolution:
[Romance • Action • Mystery • Mature Content • No Harem • Adventure]
Set in modern-day Earth where supernatural occurrences exist alongside ordinary life, a powerful global organization known as the Institute works relentlessly to suppress the truth about the horrors lurking beneath the surface of civilization.
However, some threats proved impossible to hide. Like the Wraith attacks that become too widespread, forcing governments worldwide to acknowledge their existence. Thus, Wraith emergency protocols are now taught in schools like fire drills. But Wraiths are only the surface.
Behind the scenes, the Institute recruits and trains Awakeners—rare individuals who spontaneously develop supernatural abilities, deploying them as humanity's frontline defense against threats most people will never know exist.
Amara Murray learns she's an Awakener when she runs toward a cry for help. But not just any Awakener. She's one of five special Awakeners, said to stand above the rest. Five destined to appear once every 500–1000 years.
However, she completely has zero interest in any of that crap. She simply wants to graduate, pass the bar, and make partner at one of the biggest firms in the world.…

the-german-emperor-bailedso-you-forged-a:
You were handed a dying empire on the brink of collapse—and you went and built the Third Reich?!
Transmigrated to the final days of World War I, everyone was waiting to laugh at Crown Prince Karl, the last imperial heir.
Newspapers at home and abroad already had their headlines ready: The Death of the Crown Prince, the Final Swan Song of the Old Empire!
Yet Karl unlocked his military merit system and stepped onto the smoke-choked ruins of the front lines!
[What is our goal? I can answer in one word: Victory!]
[Either claim our place under the sun, or march toward destruction!]
[Deutschland über alles!]
As his electrifying speech ended, the entire faltering nation erupted.
“We fear no death—why should we fear the Entente?!”
“Loyalty to His Highness the Crown Prince! Crush them!”
Before long, tens of thousands of advanced-generation tanks and warplanes swept across the battlefield.
The entire world’s history of war shattered!
Eight million Entente soldiers were utterly overwhelmed, and generals across every nation lost their minds:
“Who the hell taught him how to wage war like that?!”
the-skill-maker:
Trying to earn a living everyday kept Hyun-Soo busy. However, one day when he was doing a side job of threading beads, he realized something.
-Ding!
[Bead threading skill has been created] The truth was that he was the Skill Maker.
the-tale-of-the-void-emperor:

After the short unfortunate first life, he starts living his second life with more suffering that he chooses himself to get stronger but with that also comes happiness he had never experienced.

the-unrecorded-extra:
Before I woke up, I had a dream about the end of the world. At first, it felt like a vivid nightmare that left me shaken. But as I slowly woke up, I realized that the dream was the pre-ending scene of my own novel.
I am Zio Varrez, an unnamed character in my own book, and to my disappointment, an extra. As I lived in my novel's world, I couldn't help but feel that my existence was meaningless. But what made it worse was the fact that the ending of my book was the end of the world - a bad ending.
I knew I had to do something to become strong enough to change the world's fate, even if it meant altering the story I once knew completely. Little did I know, there was more to this world than I realized, and the journey I was about to embark on would uncover secrets that I never even imagined.
“I thought I knew everything about the world, but as I lived and experienced it, I realized there was so much more to it than I ever imagined.”
transmigrated-as-the-obsessive-emperors-:
Li Yuyu transmigrated into a novel and became the imperial harem's most favored concubine — whose only goal was to cuckold the Emperor.
To save her own life, Li Yuyu decisively kept her distance from the original male lead, clung tightly to the Emperor's golden thigh, and set her sights on becoming the most beloved consort in the palace!
But being the Emperor's favorite wasn't as easy as she'd imagined.
Li Yuyu: “Your Majesty, we already have three sons!”
The Emperor: “But I still don't have a princess.”
Li Yuyu：......
She regretted everything. She didn't want to be a favored concubine anymore. She wanted to escape the palace!!!
National Guardian General: “Fear not, little sister. Even if you leave the palace, your big brother will protect you forever.”
Jianghu Sovereign: “Travel the martial world with your elder brother. No one dares to lay a hand on my little sister.”
Gorgeous Senior Brother: “Come into seclusion with your senior brother, and live a carefree life without a worry in the world.”
Li Yuyu nodded frantically. Yes, yes, yes! Great, great, great!
Clang... Clang...…
